# Pancake

> Pancake is a dynasty fantasy basketball app. Every league's public data is readable anonymously as plain Markdown pages, JSON, or the Pancake CLI.

## Public league pages

- [Browse public leagues](https://ceeytbfmwsnzalxlkalc.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/public/web): Start here. Every page is Markdown with ordinary links and needs no JavaScript or sign-in.
- Find a league by name: https://ceeytbfmwsnzalxlkalc.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/public/web/leagues?query=NAME, with NAME replaced by the full name or any part of it. Matching ignores letter case. Several matches are listed for you to choose; no match says so.
- League home: https://ceeytbfmwsnzalxlkalc.supabase.co/functions/v1/api/public/web/league?league=LEAGUE_ID links to standings, schedule, matchups, scores, teams, rosters, players, free agents, statistics, projections, drafts, picks, trades and transactions.
- Every page states the league, the season and the time it was read, and links to the same data as JSON.

## Agent reference

- [Agent guide](https://pancakedynasty.vercel.app/agents.md): CLI installation, JSON API, schemas, options, pagination, limits, errors and privacy.
